prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, art-direction paintover of an existing game location. Image 1 is a current in-game screenshot from the footpath that leads from the Mega Park air station to the gate of the Mega Park, a concrete skate park set into volcanic rock in the forest of an island in autumn, in the game Yorimichi. The beige footpath runs to a short timber footbridge that crosses the park's top road under a concrete overpass hung with an indigo seigaiha wave banner and a round maple crest; on the left a red-surfaced concrete bank curves down to the road. Here the island's ground does not match the rest of the island: it is flat, dark olive-grey, untextured and faceted, the footpath is a hard-edged strip laid on it, the foot of the white concrete wall meets the ground in a hard line, and one rock is mint green. Image 2 is the island's own hamlet path in the same game and shows exactly how the island's ground looks everywhere else: a soft painterly olive and yellow-green meadow with a subtle hand-painted texture and gently rolling slopes, a sandy beige path with soft worn edges that fade into the grass, fallen autumn leaves on the path, scattered grass tufts, and round yellow-green and ochre bushes. Repaint image 1 from exactly the same camera and composition as the improved AFTER version: the paintover a lead environment artist makes to show the team how this gate should look so that walking from the station to the park feels like one place. The ground becomes the same painted meadow as image 2, gently rolling, with grass tufts, a few fallen leaves and a few small lavender-grey volcanic rocks half sunk in the grass; the mint rock becomes one of those lavender-grey rocks. The footpath keeps its line but gets soft worn edges with grass growing over them, and it meets the footbridge on a short landing of packed earth and fine grey gravel with a timber sill, so the first plank sits on the ground. The ground beside and under the footbridge dips gently into a shallow grassy dell, never a dark pit. At the foot of the white concrete wall and abutment the ground rises to meet the concrete in a band of darker earth, small grey rocks, grass and ferns, so the wall stands in the ground instead of on it. The red bank ends at a low concrete kerb with a grassy verge. The bushes stay but are fewer and lower, so the gate and the rock hillside behind read clearly. The overpass, its banner and crest, the footbridge, the red bank, the rock cliffs and the trees stay exactly as they are. Stay in the game's style; do not turn it photoreal. No people, no UI, no labels, no text.
